Payoneer

Introduction

Payoneer is a global payments platform that lets businesses, freelancers, and marketplaces send, receive, and manage funds across borders — seamlessly and securely in multiple currencies.

Year
2025
Industry
Fintech / Digital Payments / Financial Services
Scope of work
UI/UX App Design Website DesignMotionBrand Visual Identity
Timeline
10 weeks

Challenges

Designing for Payoneer involved creating a seamless and cohesive experience across multiple touchpoints — the web platform, mobile app, Apple Watch app, and landing pages.

The main challenge was to unify the visual language and interaction patterns while maintaining clarity and trust across a complex financial ecosystem.

Website

A modern, responsive website that showcases Payoneer’s cross-border services and helps users expand their global businesses.

Client Side

The redesigned Payments section increases user confidence and autonomy by making transactions transparent and frictionless. The result is fewer support requests, faster checkouts, and a smoother overall billing experience.

Mobile App

We designed the Payoneer mobile app to simplify global payments and account management with a clean, intuitive interface.

Apple Watch App

As Payoneer’s mobile experience grew, we designed an Apple Watch companion app that lets users check key business transactions right from their wrist — no phone needed. It keeps them up to date with instant alerts, quick actions, and insights they can see at a glance.

Social Part

We also created a clean, engaging social experience that extends Payoneer’s brand into a trusted community environment.

Advertising Part

Promoting Payoneer's global payment solutions through clear, impactful visuals and messaging that empathize trust, speed, and simplicity.
